mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment_outbox (event_id, event_type, aggregate_id, payload, state, retry_count, next_attempt_at, created_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{eventType}, #{aggregateId}, #{payload}, 0, 0, #{nextAttemptAt}, #{createdAt})

INSERT IGNORE INTO comment_outbox (event_id, event_type, aggregate_id, payload, state, retry_count, next_attempt_at, created_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{eventType}, #{aggregateId}, #{payload}, 0, 0, #{nextAttemptAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT event_id, event_type, aggregate_id, payload, state, retry_count, next_attempt_at, claim_token, claimed_until, last_error, created_at, published_at FROM comment_outbox WHERE state = 1 AND claim_token = #{claimToken} ORDER BY event_id
